title: Signature Item
description: A signature object containing authentication information for a specific file.

uri.description: The URI (or IRI) of the file that this signature authenticates.

signature.description: The cryptographic signature for the entire file. Standard Base64 (RFC 4648 §4); padding is mandatory when needed.

partialSignature.description: Optional signature information for a specific range within the file.

byteLength.description: The number of bytes from the byteOffset that are covered by this signature.

byteOffset.description: The byte offset from the beginning of the file where the signed range starts.

signature.description: The cryptographic signature for the specified range. Standard Base64 (RFC 4648 §4); padding is mandatory when needed.
